title: Systems from Zero
tagline: How data systems work, from first principles: what we ask of them, how one machine stores and serves data, what changes when there are many machines, and how data moves between systems, with PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Kafka, Redis, Spark and friends as the worked examples and labs on your laptop, one focused session a day.

parts.title: Foundations
parts.short: What we ask of a data system, and the network and operating system every one of them runs on.

parts.title: Data on one machine
parts.short: How one server models, stores, finds, caches and encodes data.

parts.title: Data across machines
parts.short: Copies, shards, transactions, failures, clocks and agreement, once there is more than one machine.

parts.title: Moving and deriving data
parts.short: Logs, streams and batch jobs that move data between systems and derive new data from it.

envs.what: The lab box: a Linux shell with JDK 25, strace, tcpdump, ss, tc, dig and friends (`box-priv` for privileged steps).
envs.tracks: Computer networking, Operating systems, Faults, time and truth, Batch processing and analytics

envs.what: A small network of lab boxes: two LANs, routers, a tunnel with a small MTU, a dual-stack IPv6 subnet, web servers.
PostgreSQL 18 with the course database `course` (`psql -U sfz -d course`), pageinspect and pg_stat_statements.
envs.tracks: The relational model and SQL, Data models beyond tables, Storage engines and query execution, Encoding, APIs and workflows, Transactions, Derived data and doing right

envs.what: Apache Cassandra 5.0, one node, with the payments keyspace.
envs.tracks: Data models beyond tables, Storage engines and query execution, Replication, Transactions

envs.what: DynamoDB Local on localhost:8000: the real DynamoDB API, no AWS account.
MongoDB 9.0, three members, for failover and write concern.
envs.tracks: Data models beyond tables, Partitioning, Consistency and consensus

envs.what: MongoDB 9.0 as a one-member replica set.
Neo4j Community with the fraud graph, browser on localhost:7474.
envs.tracks: Data models beyond tables, Storage engines and query execution

envs.what: OpenSearch, one node, for the search Try-its.
envs.tracks: Storage engines and query execution, Partitioning

envs.what: PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector, for vector search.
TimescaleDB on PostgreSQL 18, for time-series.
Redis Cluster with three primaries on ports 7001 to 7003.
Redis primary, replica and three Sentinels, for replication and failover.
Redis 8.10, one node (`exec redis redis-cli` for a prompt). `--profile small` adds a 4 MB server for eviction.
envs.tracks: Caching and in-memory data, Transactions, Faults, time and truth, Messaging and logs

envs.what: Cassandra 5.0, three nodes, for the ring, gossip, quorums and repair. `--profile grow` adds a fourth node and `--profile dc2` a second datacenter (about 4 GB with both); stop it with `--profile grow --profile dc2 down -v`. About 3 minutes to start.
A PostgreSQL 18 primary with a streaming standby, a replication slot and a WAL archive; `--profile pitr` adds a point-in-time restore.
Cassandra 6.0 alpha with Accord transactions, for one optional Try-it.
A sharded MongoDB 9.0 cluster: a config server replica set, two shards and a `mongos` router.
OpenSearch, three nodes, for shards, replicas and a node leaving. Uses port 9200, so stop `opensearch.yml` first.
MySQL 8.4 LTS (InnoDB) with a small `course` database, to compare its isolation levels, gap locks and undo history with PostgreSQL's
Kafka 4.4, three nodes, for replication and the ISR.
envs.tracks: Consistency and consensus, Messaging and logs

envs.what: Apache Kafka 4.4, one KRaft node on localhost:9092. Profiles add Schema Registry (`--profile schemas`) and Debezium CDC (`--profile cdc`).
RabbitMQ 4.4 with the management UI on localhost:15672, for queues, acknowledgements, redelivery and dead-lettering
